pairing.normalize_id: Remove trailing dots from browser span id and server operation_ParentId
pairing.outside_server_ms: browser.duration - server.duration, computed per matched request before aggregation
pairing.result: 103 Fetch entries matched to 103 server requests; 7 matched /answer entries
pairing.interpretation: The difference includes network, proxy, connection, client scheduling and response reading; it is not a pure network RTT.

statistics.filter: Only finite numeric values >= 0; preserve missing values as missing, exclude negative metric only, do not zero-fill
statistics.p50: Median of sorted valid raw samples
statistics.small_n: Report N and range; P95 of N=4 and N=7 equals observed maximum
statistics.turn_cohort: voice.turn and kind=answer (7 records, all heard=true)
statistics.media_cohort: voice.media grouped by interview_id; windows from same interview are correlated

timelines.voice: Use offsets inside the same event t_*; event.timestamp is emit time, not stage start
timelines.trace: Span timestamp + duration; inter-host wall clocks are not calibrated; default excludes long-lived WS, voice.session and page loading
timelines.score_pre_http_ms: child HTTP start timestamp - parent scoring.question start timestamp
timelines.extra_http_span_ms: max(HTTP start + duration) - min(HTTP start) for report-child Responses spans outside scoring.question
timelines.extra_work_classification: High confidence inference from historical source and trace topology; no explicit sop_coverage_check dimension was recorded.

platform_metrics.average_summary: Arithmetic mean of available bucket averages; not a concurrency benchmark
platform_metrics.restart_count: Counter peak, never sum across buckets
